description: NVIDIA Parakeet-TDT 0.6B v3 FastConformer-TDT ASR covering 25 European languages with automatic language detection. Supports the upstream Transformers-compatible safetensors package and standalone audio.cpp GGUF, with offline full-context, bounded-window long-form, and buffered streaming; the checkpoint uses unlimited bidirectional attention and is not a native cache-aware streaming model.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum TDT generated tokens; 0 or omitted uses the model-derived limit.

request.name: audio_chunk_mode
request.description: Offline audio chunking mode. vad uses Silero VAD to skip silence; auto keeps Parakeet's existing offline_mode behavior.

request.name: audio_chunk_duration_sec
request.description: Request-level chunk duration in seconds for fixed or VAD offline chunking. Falls back to the session chunk duration when omitted.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Shared matmul weight storage type; default native.

session.name: matmul_weight_type
session.description: Encoder and decoder matmul weight storage type; defaults to weight_type, which defaults to native. Q8_0 measured 1.79x faster on the tested CPU and changed roughly 8 percent of transcripts without moving aggregate word error rate.

session.name: conv_weight_type
session.description: Convolution weight storage type; default native.

session.name: perf_mode
session.description: Encoder attention implementation. Default off uses the validated relative-attention path; flash_attention enables the fused implementation, which was numerically validated but slower on the tested hardware.

session.name: weight_context_mb
session.description: Weight context arena size in MiB; default 3072.

session.name: encoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Encoder graph arena size in MiB; default 1024.

session.name: decoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Decoder graph arena size in MiB; default 256.

session.name: audio_chunk_duration_sec
session.description: Center-region duration for buffered streaming in seconds; default 2. Fixed context windows are re-encoded rather than cache-aware.

session.name: left_context_sec
session.description: Past context included when re-encoding each buffered-streaming window in seconds; default 10.

session.name: right_context_sec
session.description: Future lookahead included when re-encoding each buffered-streaming window in seconds; default 2 and adds equivalent partial-result latency.

session.name: streaming_attention_mode
session.description: Attention policy inside each buffered window. full_context preserves bidirectional attention over the bounded window.

session.name: offline_mode
session.description: Offline encoder scheduling. full_context encodes the whole utterance, long_form uses bounded overlapping windows, and auto selects long_form beyond audio_chunk_threshold_sec.

session.name: audio_chunk_threshold_sec
session.description: Duration threshold used by offline_mode=auto before switching to bounded-window long-form execution; default 30 seconds.

session.name: vad_model_path
session.description: Silero VAD model path used by audio_chunk_mode=vad; default assets/framework/models/silero_vad.

sizes.basis: size=tree@huggingface; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_vram=size+family overhead (derived)
size=tree@huggingface; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_vram=report peak (docs/reports)

description.en: NVIDIA Parakeet-TDT 0.6B v3 FastConformer-TDT ASR covering 25 European languages with automatic language detection. Supports the upstream Transformers-compatible safetensors package and standalone audio.cpp GGUF, with offline full-context, bounded-window long-form, and buffered streaming; the checkpoint uses unlimited bidirectional attention and is not a native cache-aware streaming model.
description.zh: NVIDIA Parakeet-TDT 0.6B v3 FastConformer-TDT ASR，覆盖 25 种欧洲语言并自动检测语言。支持上游 Transformers 兼容的 safetensors 包与独立 audio.cpp GGUF，具备离线全上下文、有界窗口长音频与缓冲式流式；该检查点使用无界双向注意力，并非原生 cache-aware 流式模型。

max_tokens.en: Maximum TDT generated tokens; 0 or omitted uses the model-derived limit.
max_tokens.zh: TDT 最多生成的 token 数；为 0 或省略时使用按模型推算的上限。

audio_chunk_mode.en: Offline audio chunking mode. vad uses Silero VAD to skip silence; auto keeps Parakeet's existing offline_mode behavior.
audio_chunk_mode.zh: 离线音频分块模式。vad 使用 Silero VAD 跳过静音；auto 保持 Parakeet 原有的 offline_mode 行为。

audio_chunk_duration_sec.en: Request-level chunk duration in seconds for fixed or VAD offline chunking. Falls back to the session chunk duration when omitted.
audio_chunk_duration_sec.zh: 固定或 VAD 离线分块时的请求级分块时长（秒）。省略时回退到会话的分块时长。
